column1: # BIOS files RetroArch's cores look for, per RetroDrive system folder (ADR-088).
# the firmware*_path / _opt / _desc lines of the named core's .info file.
# Curated: "required" = games of that system won't start without it (with that core);
# "recommended" = the core has a built-in replacement but games are more compatible with
# it; "optional" = only some games or features. Files with the same group: any one is enough.
# Paths are below the BIOS folder (RetroArch's system folder). No BIOS files are shipped.

column5: Neo Geo BIOS (or in the neogeo games folder)
